svg.text: Conceptual entity relationship diagram · 13 entities · two-branch dine-in and takeaway system
Keys: PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · PK,FK = composite key part · Relationship labels show minimum..maximum (0..* = zero or many; 1..* = one or many).
Optional customer, table, and stock-movement order links are shown; refunds reference the original payment for that order.
